segments.name: Institutional lending
segments.description: Institutional lender providing senior secured loans, primarily to state law compliant cannabis operators in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment and has one reportable operating segment for activities related to institutional lending.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest income on loans to state law compliant cannabis operators, typically secured by real estate, equipment, cash flows and license value.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenue from loans to state law compliant cannabis operators in the United States.

changes.text: In 2024, the company spun off its commercial real estate loan portfolio into Sunrise Realty Trust, an independent publicly traded REIT.
changes.evidence: On July 9, 2024, the Company completed the spin-off (the "Spin-Off") of the Company's wholly-owned subsidiary, Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. ("SUNS"), which held the Company's commercial real estate ("CRE") loan portfolio, into an independent, publicly traded REIT, SUNS.

changes.text: In 2025, the Board approved the Sixth Amendment expanding the investment strategy to companies ancillary to and outside the cannabis industry.
changes.evidence: At a meeting of the Board of Directors (the "Board") on August 12, 2025 (the "August Meeting"), the Board approved the sixth amendment to the Company's existing Management Agreement (the "Sixth Amendment") to expand the Company's investment strategy.
